items.title: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
items.summary: Security researchers found a vulnerability in the APIs of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google that lets them extract encrypted reasoning traces and move them between models. A scan of public sessions turned up dozens of passwords and API keys. The traces also show that the reasoning summaries users see often hide what the models are actually doing....

items.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
items.summary: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.

items.title: Anthropic watermarks all Claude outputs globally with marks that "may persist through some editing"
items.summary: Anthropic will embed invisible watermarks in all Claude-generated text and sign files using the C2PA standard. New models shipping from August 2026 onward will have labeling built in from day one. The policy applies worldwide, and Anthropic plans to provide detection tools for third-party verification....
